questions.question: I _____ finished my homework.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم have مع I لتكوين المضارع التام، ويأتي بعده التصريف الثالث للفعل.

questions.question: She has _____ her breakfast. (eat)
questions.explanation_ar: التصريف الثالث من eat هو eaten.

questions.question: They have _____ to Dubai twice.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم been وهو التصريف الثالث من be في المضارع التام.

questions.question: I have _____ cleaned my room.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم already غالبًا في الجمل المثبتة للتعبير عن أن الفعل حدث بالفعل.

questions.question: Have you finished your project _____?
questions.explanation_ar: تأتي yet غالبًا في نهاية السؤال بالمضارع التام، بمعنى حتى الآن.

questions.question: I have lived here _____ 2020.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم since مع نقطة بداية زمنية محددة مثل سنة 2020.

questions.question: She has studied English _____ three years.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم for مع مدة زمنية مثل three years.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: He have not finished his work.
questions.correct_answer: He has not finished his work.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم has مع he وshe وit، وليس have.

questions.question: I think it _____ rain tomorrow.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم will للتعبير عن توقع أو قرار يتعلق بالمستقبل.

questions.question: Do not worry. I _____ help you.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم will للتعبير عن قرار أو وعد بالمساعدة.

questions.question: Look at those dark clouds! It _____ rain.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم is going to عندما توجد دلائل واضحة على حدوث شيء في المستقبل.

questions.question: They are _____ to visit their grandparents next week.
questions.explanation_ar: التركيب الصحيح هو am/is/are going to ثم الفعل الأساسي.

questions.question: The phone is ringing. I _____ answer it.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم will هنا لقرار اتُّخذ لحظة التحدث.

questions.question: If you study hard, you _____ pass the exam.
questions.explanation_ar: في الشرط الأول نستخدم المضارع البسيط بعد if، وwill في النتيجة المتوقعة.

questions.question: If it rains, we _____ at home.
questions.explanation_ar: النتيجة المستقبلية في الشرط الأول تأتي عادةً مع will.

questions.question: Match each technology word with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه مفردات تقنية شائعة في استخدام الحاسوب والأجهزة الإلكترونية.

questions.question: Which information should you keep private online?
questions.explanation_ar: يجب عدم مشاركة كلمة المرور مع الآخرين حفاظًا على الحسابات والخصوصية.

questions.question: You can _____ a photo with a camera.
questions.explanation_ar: نقول take a photo بمعنى يلتقط صورة.

questions.question: The girl _____ won the race is my sister.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم who للإشارة إلى الأشخاص.

questions.question: This is the house _____ I was born.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم where للإشارة إلى المكان.

questions.passage: Mona has bought a new tablet. She uses it to read stories and learn English. She has already downloaded two educational games. Her mother helps her choose safe websites. Mona does not share her password with anyone. Next week, she is going to create a school presentation.
questions.question: What does Mona use her tablet for?
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أن منى تستخدم الجهاز لقراءة القصص وتعلم اللغة الإنجليزية.

questions.passage: Mona has bought a new tablet. She uses it to read stories and learn English. She has already downloaded two educational games. Her mother helps her choose safe websites. Mona does not share her password with anyone. Next week, she is going to create a school presentation.
questions.question: How many educational games has Mona downloaded?
questions.explanation_ar: ورد في النص أنها حمّلت لعبتين تعليميتين.

questions.passage: Mona has bought a new tablet. She uses it to read stories and learn English. She has already downloaded two educational games. Her mother helps her choose safe websites. Mona does not share her password with anyone. Next week, she is going to create a school presentation.
questions.question: What is Mona going to do next week?
questions.explanation_ar: تقول الجملة الأخيرة إنها تخطط لإعداد عرض مدرسي في الأسبوع القادم.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order: has / already / she / arrived
questions.explanation_ar: يأتي الفاعل أولًا، ثم has، ثم already، ثم التصريف الثالث arrived.

questions.question: Write three sentences about what you are going to do next weekend.

criteria: Use am, is, or are going to correctly.
rubric.sample_answer: I am going to visit my grandmother. I am going to play football with my friends. I am going to read a new book.

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب ثلاث جمل عن خططك القادمة، واستخدم am/is/are going to بصورة صحيحة.
